name: hyperwolf-pos-admin
description: Hyperwolf POS-Admin. The apps are JSX with no build step FOR DEVELOPMENT: locally and on GitHub Pages the browser still transforms them, so editing a .jsx and reloading is the whole loop. The DEPLOYED copy is precompiled — tools/precompile.mjs runs the same @babel/standalone transform at deploy time so the browser never loads a compiler. Nothing compiled is ever committed.
